## Doctrine and review checklist

- [ ] I checked whether this PR changes product doctrine, doctrine-linked specs, or both.
- [ ] If doctrine-linked specs changed, the doctrine contract still passes.
- [ ] If governance or audit surfaces changed, replay and evidence expectations were reviewed.
- [ ] This PR does not reintroduce cross-repo workspace / OS / agent-plane doctrine into product-only files.
- [ ] Privacy for persons and transparency for institutional power remain intact.

## Summary

Describe what changed and why it improves the product or its constitutional enforcement layer.
